ground_truth.strain_convention: engineering / small strain: eps_xx = e_x * t, eps_yy = e_y * t, gamma_xy = 0 (parameter strains, uniform for the affine model); eps_*_img are the components of sym(J) - I in the image frame

noise.clipping: grey levels clipped to [0, 255] and rounded when writing the 8-bit PNG

notes: This directory is fully regenerated by dicgen; unrelated files are never touched.
Same seed + same arguments produce byte-identical files.
Displacement/strain values are analytic ground truth, not measured.

sampling.out_of_bounds: filled with the background grey level and flagged invalid in the mask
sampling.valid_mask: X inside [0, W-1] x [0, H-1]; bicubic mode also shrinks by 2 px of stencil

sequence.deformed_coordinates: x = center + F_i (X - center) + t_i * T
